description:
Full-text search INSIDE the documents Georgia agencies released to Georgia Prisoners' Speak under the
    Georgia Open Records Act and GPS has published at https://gps.press/records/ (contracts, purchase orders,
    price lists, inspection reports, policies, staffing matrices and more). Returns each matching file with its
    record, public download URL, number of occurrences and up to three passages with the page they fall on.
    q: words to find (3+ characters, matched as typed, case-insensitive), e.g. "AirWarden", "Medically
    Intensive Infirmary", "per offender per month". ref: limit to one record, e.g. 'R032595-101926'.
    Scanned pages are searched through GPS's OCR text where it exists. Use get_public_records for the
    record itself (request as sent, agency answers, cost, every file).
name: search_public_records
title: Search public records
